headlines.title: UFC’s Dana White says he will meet Trump on Monday to discuss press secretary offer
headlines.description: President Donald Trump said that he’d offered the job of White House press secretary to the CEO and president of the Ultimate Fighting Championship, Dana White.

headlines.title: House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries says he is a ‘hard yes’ on impeaching Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth
headlines.description: House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries, D-N.Y., said he is a “hard yes” on supporting impeachment efforts against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth

headlines.title: Post Game: ‘Treacherous territory for the administration’
headlines.description: Jonathan Martin, Marc Short, and Ashley Etienne join the Meet the Press Post Game for an extended conversation on the week’s biggest political stories.

headlines.title: San Francisco Mayor on Efforts to Revitalize the City
headlines.description: San Francisco Mayor Daniel Lurie was elected on a platform of fixing issues of income inequality, homelessness, open drug use, and corruption at city hall. Now, the California city is in the midst of a comeback, with a strict crime crackdown and an influx of money from an "AI gold rush." In this week's Sunday Spotlight, NBC's Sam Brock sits down with Mayor Lurie, as well as former Apple design chief Jony Ive, to discuss their faith in the city.

headlines.title: Shapiro 2028? Pennsylvania Gov. says he’s focused on the commonwealth ‘right now’
headlines.description: After winning re-election, Gov. Josh Shapiro (D-Pa.) says he’s focused on governing in the commonwealth after Democrats flipped the state senate to give them a trifecta.

headlines.title: Early midterm voting data shows enthusiasm ahead of election day
headlines.description: With millions of Americans having already voted, NBC News Director of Elections John Lapinski analyzes early midterm voting data and key races to watch on election night.

headlines.title: Sen.-elect Adam Hamilton says he’d be disappointed if Democrats focus on investigating Trump
headlines.description: Sen.-elect Adam Hamilton said that he hopes to prioritize lowering costs and that he would be “deeply disappointed” to spend two years investigating Trump.

headlines.title: Gov. Josh Shapiro urges Democrats to prioritize healthcare, food assistance
headlines.description: Pennsylvania Gov. Josh Shapiro said he hopes Democrats prioritize healthcare and food assistance when they take control of Congress in January, though he urged them not to forget to hold the Trump administration accountable.

headlines.title: James Talarico kicks off ‘SNL’ days after historic Texas Senate win
headlines.description: James Talarico, a Democrat whose U.S. Senate victory this week was once thought improbable in the Republican stronghold of Texas, made a surprise appearance to help kick off the latest episode of “Saturday Night Live.”

headlines.title: Trump names Stephen Miller his new chief of staff, replacing Susie Wiles
headlines.description: President Donald Trump has turned to MAGA favorite Stephen Miller to lead the White House after Republicans got trounced in Tuesday’s midterm elections, losing both chambers of Congress by wide margins.

headlines.title: The White House’s post-election shake-up: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: In today’s edition, we dive into President Donald Trump’s decision to make a change at chief of staff. Plus, Kristen Welker examines how voters once again rejected the status quo.

headlines.title: Florida candidate sues election official, alleging bias in a razor-thin race
headlines.description: MIAMI — South Florida Democratic congressional candidate Eliott Rodriguez filed a federal lawsuit against the Miami-Dade supervisor of elections Friday, citing bias after she declined to recuse herself from the recount process.
